home.stage: Stage: {stage} — engineering foundation in place; pages land per FE-01 onward.

design.theme.label: Baseline
design.modal.title: Delete 3 layers

design.drawer.title: AI assistant (drawer sample)
design.state.empty.title: No files yet

design.state.error.title: Cannot reach the local service
design.state.error.desc: Make sure the daemon is running, then retry.
design.toast.failed: Export failed: not enough disk space
design.field.name: Layer name
design.tip: hover / active are reproduced with state-forcing classes (dfg-state-hover / dfg-state-active); focus-visible is captured by the screenshot gate with a real focus.

market.license.loadable.label: Installable
market.license.loadable.notice: Permissive license (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause / CC0-1.0 / Unlicense): installable, bundled with the license text and upstream attribution.
market.license.viewOnly.label: View only
market.license.viewOnly.notice: License tier disallows installation (NOASSERTION / custom terms / AGPL-3.0 / no license / archived): browsable and traceable, not installable.
market.license.blocked.label: Blocked
market.license.blocked.notice: License forbids redistribution, asset yanked, or brand-derived risk: excluded from the market list.
market.install.viewOnlyReason: License tier disallows installation: source, license text and scores remain readable.
market.install.blockedReason: License forbids redistribution / yanked / brand-derived risk.
market.capability.promptInject.label: Inject prompt
market.capability.promptInject.scope: Granted by default: injects instructions only, no side effects.
market.capability.fsRead.label: Read project files
market.capability.fsRead.scope: Project working directory only (path normalization + escape detection).
market.capability.fsWrite.label: Write project files
market.capability.fsWrite.scope: Project working directory only (dryRun preview before writing).
market.capability.mcp.label: Call MCP tools
market.capability.subprocess.label: Spawn subprocess
market.capability.subprocess.scope: Denied by default: requires explicit approval on the install confirmation bar, audited per call.
market.capability.bash.label: Run shell commands
market.capability.bash.scope: Denied by default: requires explicit approval on the install confirmation bar, audited per call.
market.capability.network.label: Network access
market.capability.connector.label: Connector call
market.capability.connector.scope: Requires a declared domain allowlist; credentials stay in the local vault.
market.capability.comfyGenerate.label: Local image generation
market.capability.comfyGenerate.scope: Loopback address only, template parameters only.
market.capability.llmCall.label: LLM call
market.capability.llmCall.scope: Via the adapter layer (DeepSeek by default) + budget gate.
market.capability.unknown.scope: Capability outside the lexicon: requires explicit approval (never optimistic).
market.title: Skill marketplace
market.subtitle: Four GitHub asset kinds (skills / plugins / design systems / templates): five-dimension scoring plus license gating, with per-capability confirmation before install.
market.search.label: Search market assets
market.search.placeholder: Search name / summary / tags / source repo
market.filter.sort.name: Name
market.scene.label: Browse by scene
market.empty.noResult.title: No matching assets
market.empty.noResult.desc: Try another keyword or clear the filters.
market.empty.indexMissing.title: No market index yet
market.empty.indexMissing.desc: The index is the only source of truth for market cards: nothing is shown (and nothing is faked) until the collector has run.
market.empty.indexInvalid.title: Market index cannot be parsed
market.empty.indexInvalid.desc: The index does not match df.marketplace.index/v1 (version or fields); re-run collection with validation, then reopen the market.
market.empty.installed.title: No assets installed yet
market.empty.installed.desc: Pick an asset in Market; once the install confirmation (capability list + one-time token) completes, local records show up here.
market.error.title: Cannot reach the local service
market.warning.partial: Some community results failed to load: {message}
market.quality.title: Five-dimension score (explainable)
market.quality.noDeductions: No deductions provided for this asset (nothing is invented when explain is missing).
market.deduct.s2: S2 Description does not state when to use it
market.deduct.m1: M1 Not updated for over a year
market.deduct.m2: M2 Dormant repo (long inactive, low traction)
market.deduct.l1: L1 License tier is not installable (no deduction; gated)
market.cap.list.title: Capability list
market.cap.empty: This asset declares no capabilities (index applies the default).
market.cap.ackList: Approved one by one in the confirmation bar: {list}
market.load.title: Install “{name}”
market.load.desc: Proposal → user confirmation → single-transaction write → audit trail; capabilities and license are shown verbatim, never optimistically.
market.load.attributionValue: Bundle the license text and upstream attribution (source {repo}); assets without a license must not be redistributed.
market.load.overwriteNotice: A local record already exists: after confirmation the digest comparison decides an update, and the write overwrites the target path (spec §7.4).
market.load.tokenExpired: The one-time token has expired (not approved/written in time) — start the install confirmation again.
market.load.tokenUsed: This token was already consumed (one-time) — repeated confirmation is rejected.
market.load.alreadyApproved: Already approved: the token is not re-issued; proceed to confirm the write.
market.load.notLoadable: Not installable: the license tier forbids it (spec §7.2).
market.load.auditHint: Audit fields: asset id / commit / digest / granted capabilities / approval time / caller.
market.load.success: Installed “{name}”: local record and audit created.
market.detail.previewPlaceholder: No preview asset (preview/ first image): nothing is generated as a stand-in; see source and license on the right.
market.detail.author: Author
market.detail.noOverview: No long-form overview (the index carries no description); nothing is invented.
market.detail.translationNotice: Original text (English) below: the UI stays Chinese-only (ADR-0003); asset text keeps its original language, code and field names verbatim.
market.detail.usageNote: Example prompts come from the asset's own docs (the current index has no prompts field): judge fit by tags and scenes, then open the source for details.
market.detail.installHint: Installation follows the controlled three-step flow: dryRun preview → approve and issue a one-time token → single-transaction write with audit; capabilities and license confirmed item by item.
market.detail.yanked: Yanked: {reason} ({at} · source {source}) — installed assets are never dropped silently; uninstall here.
market.detail.notFound.title: Asset not found
market.detail.notFound.desc: It may be uncollected or yanked (daemon returned market_asset_not_found), or the link went stale after an index update.
market.detail.error.title: Cannot load asset details
market.load.loadedDone: Installed: the local record and audit entry were created.
market.featuredHint: Featured = top {count} of the current results by quality score (spec §6.2).
market.loadPlanError: Failed to fetch the install proposal: {message} (install entry disabled until fixed)
market.clientFilterNote: License tier / source repo / installed / featured are client-side filters over the current result page (beyond the daemon query params); {count} filters active.
market.panel.title: Market panel
market.panel.subtitle: In-editor (dark): browse + dry-run + adopt
market.panel.pageHint: Standalone dark route (until the editor shell FE-03 lands): panel list + detail + dry-run (no side effects) + local adoption counts.
market.panel.empty: Nothing to show right now (empty index).
market.panel.runNote: Dry-run by default: only lists the capabilities and injection point; no network/subprocess calls and no document changes.
market.panel.gate: Install gate (three states): {label} — the real write goes through the confirmation dialog; the panel offers no bypass.
market.panel.feedbackKey: Local counting key: {key} (telemetry is local-only by default; viewable and deletable)
dashboard.title: Data dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Collection progress, four-layer status and the three quality boards (spec §6.2 / v1.1 §7.6).
dashboard.hint: Metrics come only from daemon /market/query and its cards; anything unknown is marked “not reported” rather than faked as 0. Thresholds await MK (spec §9.11), so values are shown without verdicts.
dashboard.progress.title: Collection progress
dashboard.progress.loadedNote: The page loads {loaded} of {total} cards (paged window); distribution metrics cover the loaded subset.
dashboard.notReportedReason: This field is not part of the /market/query response (a daemon extension or direct ADS read is needed) — the dashboard never guesses.
dashboard.layers.title: Four-layer status (ODS/DWD/DWS/ADS)
dashboard.layer.unreportedNote: Not reported (the collector's artifact manifest is not exposed by the daemon)
dashboard.layer.adsNote: The index is the ADS artifact: card count and generation time come from the index itself.
dashboard.quality.title: Quality boards
dashboard.quality.thresholdsPending: Pass/fail thresholds await MK (spec §9.11): values and distributions only, no verdict.
dashboard.completeness.title: Completeness (field missing rate)
dashboard.consistency.title: Consistency (duplicates, dangling references)
dashboard.consistency.explain: Duplicate digests mean identical content across cards (a signal of unmerged near-duplicates); dangling references mean a missing content hash or license evidence.
dashboard.freshness.title: Timeliness (freshness distribution)
dashboard.empty: No index data: the dashboard draws no conclusions (run the collector first).
market.detail.planLoading: Loading the install proposal (the button is enabled once the dryRun preview is ready)…
